text:
Rina: Thanks for joining the Q&A. Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the reliability incident. RCA posted: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Using this thread to capture owners, short ETAs, and cross-team follow-ups. Please keep replies short. :spiral_notepad:

Lee: I'll take lead on the emergency mitigation checklist and the KV config rollback doc. Target: 2026-03-28 09:00 UTC. I'll add steps to `playbooks/kv-cache-rollback.md` and include a canary verification script.

Omar: I'll own the oncall tuning changes and alert thresholds. Plan to update the runbook and create a Prometheus alert: new rule to detect 3 consecutive 1m buckets with stall_rate > 0.015. ETA: 2026-03-28 14:00 UTC.

Priya: I can draft the customer-facing note for Hosted and Dedicated tiers. Will include impact summary, mitigation, and expected next steps. Draft 1 by 2026-03-28 12:00 UTC. Need Legal/PR signoff afterwards.

Ankur: I'll handle the Dedicated capacity ops play and reach out to top 5 affected accounts. ETA for account contact list and outreach template: 2026-03-28 16:00 UTC.

StatusBot: Created ticket INC-2026-042-FOLLOWUPS and linked tasks (mitigation, runbook, comms, acct-outreach): https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-FOLLOWUPS.

Rina: From leadership Q&A we need explicit answers: 1) Are SLOs being modified? 2) Is there a temporary Dedicated reservation for at-risk customers? 3) Who owns the regression watch for the next 7 days?

Lee: No SLO changes today. We'll propose micro-adjustments if rollback does not fully restore baseline within 72h.

Ankur: We can provision a short-term Dedicated buffer for top-tier customers for up to 48h (manual approval by Ops leads). I'll prepare the approval request once we have the account list.

Omar: Regression watch: Platform Reliability team will run elevated monitoring with daily checks at 09:00 UTC. I'll post a morning snapshot GIF/dashboard link here each day.

Priya: For comms, I'll post draft here and ping Legal/PR in thread. If anyone has wording preferences (technical vs non-technical) say now; otherwise I'll default to plain-language + link to RCA.

Lee: Verification commands I'll include in the rollback doc:
```
# smoke test cache layer
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/kv-proxy -- curl -sS localhost:8080/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit_ratio
# simple load check
wrk -t2 -c50 -d10s http://internal-loadtest/priming
```

Ankur: Also adding a runbook appendix for Dedicated customer mitigation steps (node pin + instance resize + traffic drain). Will reference `docs/dedicated/migrations.md`.

Rina: Good. Action items recap: Lee (rollback doc + smoke tests) | Omar (alerts + runbook) | Priya (customer comms draft) | Ankur (dedicated outreach). Everyone drop the doc/task link when done. I'll assemble a consolidated tracker and schedule a 48-hour sync.

Priya: Draft posted: https://redwood.company/drafts/comm-INC-2026-042 (please comment inline). Tagging @Legal and @PR.

Omar: Added Prometheus rule and dashboard panel: https://grafana.internal/d/kv-incident. Alert expression: `increase(kv_stall_total[3m]) / increase(kv_req_total[3m]) > 0.015`.

StatusBot: Follow-up ticket updated with assignees and ETAs. Next status update due 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC.

Rina: Thanks. One ask from leadership: include a short note on "what we changed operationally" for the next all-hands slide. Can someone drop a 2-3 line blurb here by EOD tomorrow?

Lee: Blurb: "Rolled back recent KV cache change, tightened detection thresholds, and established a 7-day elevated monitoring window with targeted capacity options for Dedicated customers."

Rina: Perfect 9 — closing thread for updates. Please keep all edits and final links in this thread so I can export the tracker. :white_check_mark:
